AGP813_pinned_internal_metadata_facts.AAR_publish_call: publish(SingleArtifact.AAR, ArtifactType.AAR) is a distinct publication route, not proof a full AAR is selectable on the existing local runtime variant
AGP813_pinned_internal_metadata_facts.scope_label: Actual project compiled classpath JARs; not every AGP packaging intermediate. Full source manifests/whole APK checks remain distinct proofs.

concrete_acceptable_proposal: For each exact original debugRuntimeClasspath and releaseRuntimeClasspath, retain full original graph resolution/rethrowFailure/component checks and selected modules/projects.

Build a strict module-component ArtifactView with no added attributes and no reselection; read its original raw external JAR/AAR results. Do not request jar/android-classes-jar for external AAR modules and do not replace raw records with transformed cache results.

Build a strict project-component ArtifactView for the pinned actual android-classes-jar secondary artifact type, inheriting original configuration attributes and without reselection. Preserve actual canonical project build-output paths and existing JAR/AAR parser.

Lazily bind task dependencies to both exact view file collections for both configurations, so selected producer tasks run before inspection without attempting the default ambiguous artifact projection.

Union results by their original module/project identity, retain duplicate/unknown/missing checks, and let existing parser preserve bounded safe single-link regular reads, exact coordinate/project containment, full npm source/MIT/policy and external POM/notice/bin provenance.

Keep the existing :app root exclusion and primary validated packaging=pom metadata-only module treatment. Any new exceptional exemption would need primary selected identity/category/metadata evidence; do not exempt arbitrary missing binaries.

Describe the project evidence precisely as selected compiled classpath JAR inputs while preserving whole APK/permissions/source/repeat/comparison guards. Do not claim classes JAR byte identity proves all AGP resource/native intermediate bytes.

existing_contract.meaning: Selected exact debug/release component graphs and actual JAR/AAR inputs; external binary/coordinate/POM/notice provenance; local installed npm full source/MIT/license hashes and bundled-binary refusal. Whole APK/permission/source/repeat comparison is separate.
existing_contract.not_a_new_requirement: No new resource-directory/intermediate-byte identity schema or proof architecture is required by this review. Earlier all-physical-intermediate wording was broader than the actual existing contract and is withdrawn.

finite_candidate_acceptance_controls: Actual minimal secondary-variant ambiguity before/after and actual AGP exact-source before/after if available; component/module/project graph identities remain the same and output is complete in both exact runtime views.

External raw module artifact hashes/filenames/coordinate-bound physical cache paths and POM/license/notice evidence unchanged relative to an independent no-attribute module view, including an external AAR carrying resources/native entries.

Strict explicit-attributed missing-project-artifact control must refuse despite Gradle silently omitting it; missing a required binary module must also refuse. Metadata-only platform/POM and exact root do not create false required-binary failures.
Each runtime view producer dependency removal must fail a meaningful missing/not-built producer witness; wrong build-type/foreign project/unknown component and resolution failures remain failures.

Unchanged parser/source/license/unsafe-file/bundled-binary/closed-SDK/caps/status/fault/reset and whole APK/repeat/reference/comparison guards remain hashbound; no full native-card reopening is required for unchanged code.
not_established: Actual selected component metadata for the failed AGP run; graph output remains absent
public_Gradle_facts: ArtifactView filters selected artifact results by component identity; filtering does not replace complete dependency graph checks or drop transitive components from the graph.

Without withVariantReselection, requested view attributes merge onto original configuration attributes. withVariantReselection ignores the original configuration attributes and can select a different graph variant; do not invoke it for this adapter.

Explicit view attributes set allowNoMatchingVariants=true in pinned implementation even with lenient=false, so absence of an attributed artifact may silently produce zero results. Preserve explicit existing selected-project/module binary coverage checks.

ArtifactCollection.artifactFiles is public task-input wiring; resolvedArtifacts Provider tracks producer tasks. Producer dependencies must come lazily from the exact views/files being read, not from the former ambiguous default config.buildDependencies.
ResolvedComponentResult.variants can include more than one selected variant. An implementation must not replace the graph with the artifact view; existing graph evidence remains mandatory.

Category platform/enforced-platform documents constraint metadata; graph root has no own resolved dependency artifact. Existing exact root exclusion and validated POM packaging metadata-only treatment stay explicit; no broad missing-component exemption.
